bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; establishing for certain customized living providers an exemption from the community living setting licensing moratorium and the commissioner's authority to manage statewide community living setting capacity; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 245A.03, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 245A.03, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 7a.

Licensing moratorium exception; former customized living settings.

(a) Notwithstanding subdivision 7 and section 256B.493, if the commissioner determines that the setting complies with all applicable rules and laws, the commissioner shall issue an initial license for a community residential setting that was a customized living service setting serving people under the brain injury or community access for disability inclusion waiver plans under section 256B.49 in a single-family home and was operational on June 30, 2025. "Operational" has the meaning given in section 256B.49, subdivision 28, paragraph (e).

(b) The commissioner shall issue licenses under this subdivision for a licensed capacity equal to the capacity of the customized living setting on June 30, 2025, not to exceed five.

(c) Eligible applicants must apply for a community residential setting under this subdivision by June 30, 2027.

(d) The commissioner's authority under subdivision 7 and section 256B.493 to manage statewide licensed community residential settings capacity, including the reduction and realignment of licensed capacity of a community residential setting, does not apply to settings licensed under this subdivision.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.
